item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #SLPRSD
Issued at 07:40 PM 14 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Mansalay, Bulalacao, Socorro, Pola, Victoria), #Marinduque(Gasan, Buenavista and Torrijos) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Gloria, Pinamalayan, Bansud, Bongabong and Roxas) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
